---
name: Feature request / discussion
about: Propose a new component, model, or contribution direction
title: "[DISCUSSION] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Engineering context

What problem are you trying to solve? (e.g. "PCHE non-circular channel
heat transfer in a TMSR secondary loop")

## What does the toolkit lack today?

Specific gap — be concrete. Vague requests get parked.

## Proposed contribution

Small, mid, large? Sketch the deliverable:

- File(s) to add / modify
- Approximate equation set (reference literature)
- Test coverage you'd add
- Documentation updates

## References

Cite at least one peer-reviewed paper, lab report, or standard. Speculative
"someone might want this" requests without literature backing are unlikely
to be merged.

## Have you checked compatibility?

- [ ] This direction matches `docs/00_strategy.md` strategy
- [ ] This work would not duplicate an existing CoolProp / OpenModelica feature
